items.title: Joe Harris Interview, 1961-04-12
items.q: I heard talk of Smiling Lewis, huh?

ctx.x: Yeah, Walter Delarose. That's Walter Delarose left under, that's where you catch your hair.
Yeah, I was coming off of Bourbon Street, I think, I was coming off of Bourbon Street, Smiling Lewis, Smiling Joe. Yeah, I heard talk of Smiling Lewis, huh?
Oh, yeah. Yeah, I don't think we know too much about him, though.
